purpose: Frozen pure-retrieval decision package requested in shiwenwen/hope-agent#802.

annotation_provenance.policy: All tool names, descriptions, parameter contracts, semantic field IDs, units, and supported/unsupported topic boundaries are frozen before any hope-agent result is observed. No model-generated labels are used.

comparison_boundary.eligible_catalog: The full catalog remains eligible for both systems. Preselection/deferral must not be interpreted as deleting other eligible capabilities.
comparison_boundary.schema_budget_encoding: UTF-8 bytes of canonical JSON (sort_keys=true, separators=(',', ':')) for actually exposed schemas.

stages.activation: Tools made callable/active for the next model turn.
stages.exposed_schema: Exact schemas actually inserted into model-visible context after activation or SchemaRouter projection.

comparison_boundary.ambiguous: No tool should be activated without disambiguating information; acceptable_candidate_tools may appear as candidates.

latency.cold_start: For each case, create a fresh router/index instance from the frozen catalog; include catalog parsing and index construction through retrieval/activation result; exclude operating-system process launch.
latency.hot_path: Reuse one initialized router/index, perform 3 unmeasured warmups, then report the median of 20 measured retrieval/activation runs for the same case.

metrics: supported required-field recall from actually exposed schemas

hope_agent_semantics.note: Preserve resolve_tool_fate eligibility and native deferred/tool_search behavior. Candidate, activation, and actual schema exposure are scored separately.
